mechanism: Torsemide-induced hypokalemia and volume depletion are counteracted by eplerenone's potassium-sparing and sodium-retaining effects, creating opposing pharmacodynamic actions that increase hyperkalemia and fluid retention risk.
action: Monitor serum potassium, creatinine, and blood pressure closely; adjust diuretic dosing based on electrolyte levels and clinical response; educate patient on dietary potassium restriction.
